text.en: 1. These Rules may be cited as the Housing and Development (Application of Part IV to Design-Build-And-Sell Scheme) Rules.
2. In these Rules, “DBSS flat” means any housing accommodation sold or to be sold by an approved developer under Part IVB of the Act.

heading.en: Application of Part IV of Act with exceptions

text.en: 3. Subject to such modifications as are specified in rule 4, the provisions of Part IV of the Act shall apply to a DBSS flat as they apply in relation to a flat sold or to be sold by the Board under Part IV of the Act, with the exception of sections 47(6), 48, 55(1)(a) and 65(1)(a) of the Act.

4. Section 48B of the Act shall have effect with the modification that the Board may execute an instrument on behalf of a person, and may be the duly appointed attorney of such a person, under that section only in connection with or for the purpose of a mortgage of a DBSS flat.
[G.N. No. S 13/2006]
